commits.messageBody:
Keep Win32 unsigned-long byte-count ABI; use uint64_t on Win64. Widen allocator byte accounting, getters and consumers, preserve signed deltas, and calculate the garbage-collection threshold without int multiplication overflow. Correct matching diagnostic formats. No allocation policy, null-reallocate or vendor changes.

Validation: real VS2013 native diagnostic probes passed 11/11 on Win32/x64 Debug/Release. Counters were deliberately seeded near UINT32_MAX and exercised by small actual allocations; this does not claim a resident multi-GiB heap. Eight client consumer translation units compiled in all four configurations (32/32). Viewer and MayaExporter edits have source review only, outside that build closure. Full product linkage/live garbage-collection behavior remains separate.
commits.messageHeadline: memory: retain full-width x64 byte statistics through consumers

commits.messageBody: Use %p with void-pointer arguments instead of unsigned-int casts. This changes diagnostic formatting only. Native v120 extracted-expression compilation passes both ABIs; explicitly enabled C4311 rejects the old x64 conversion. No allocator fault workload or runtime behavior is exercised by that compile proof.
commits.messageHeadline: memory: keep full addresses in free-pattern diagnostics

commits.messageBody:
Avoid reading a nonexistent block header for tracked null-positive reallocations. Use the existing zero-owner/no-leak defaults in the core allocator. XML and OCI null-positive adapters invoke their existing array-allocation hooks so their matching delete[] hooks retain the allocation domain. Null-zero and nonnull paths are unchanged.

Sixteen native compile checks pass across both ABIs/configurations, including tracked/scalar/guarded MemoryManager and genuine OCI headers. Compiled copies differ only in documented Windows line endings. No runtime null/fault probe was performed; allocation lifecycle acceptance remains open. Server copies use different allocation domains and have no matching custom allocator hunk.
commits.messageHeadline: memory: preserve allocation metadata rules for null reallocation
